title: Truth of Life
author: masaharu-taniguchi
attributionNote: Written by Masaharu Taniguchi, founder of Seicho-no-Ie. It is a modern movement text.
description: A multi-volume exposition of Seicho-no-Ie teaching, emphasising the true image of humanity, gratitude and the immanence of God. It is not a historical scripture.
historicalContext: Published from 1930 in Japan and revised over decades. The movement’s teachings and publications developed in a modern Japanese context.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Modern publications are copyrighted and no verified translation is imported.
